channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: SEBI revamps Mutual Fund rules to boost cost transparency, ease investor burden
item.description: According to the report, the changes were cleared by the SEBI board and will be implemented through the new SEBI (Mutual Funds) Regulations, 2026, replacing the existing 1996 framework after a detailed review.

item.title: Santosh trophy row: J&K govt orders high-level probe into team selection
item.description: Amid allegations of bias against players from the Jammu region, the Jammu and Kashmir government has constituted a high-level enquiry committee to examine the selection process of the J&K football team for the 79th Santosh Trophy.

item.title: Indian Army scripts history as tanks, artillery reach Kashmir in special military train; why is it important
item.description: The Indian Army has achieved a historic logistics milestone by transporting tanks and artillery guns into the Kashmir Valley for the first time through a special military train. The movement, enabled by the Udhampur–Srinagar–Baramulla Rail Link, strengthens all-weather military mobility.

item.title: What's so special about December 21 this year?
item.description: Gurudev is set to lead the World Meditation Day events from UN headquarters in Geneva on 17 December and then the world's largest global meditation event on December 21 from The World Trade Center, where millions of people from 180 countries are expected to join.

item.title: Wholesale Jewellery Brand Regal Jewellers Celebrates First Anniversary in Bengaluru with Celebrity Presence
item.description: Actress Shwetha Prasad spoke of the brand's massive growth in Bengaluru and highlighted their USP of offering stunning jewellery at wholesale value.

item.title: Travel Like You Mean It: Akshay Mirchandani (@niftystretch's) Travel Philosophy & Insider Tips
item.description: Travel isn't about destinations. It's about becoming gradually more yourself through understanding how other people live

item.title: US says India remains 'key partner' despite not joining Pax Silica
item.description: Speculation linking India's absence to political tensions with Washington was misplaced and incorrect, Under Secretary of State for Economic Affairs Jacob Helberg told reporters at a news conference organised by the Foreign Press Centre here.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty open lower amid weak global cues
item.description: At around 9:23 a.m., the 30-share Sensex was trading at 84,434.8, down 124.77 points or 0.15 per cent. The Nifty slipped 22.15 points, or 0.08 per cent, to 25,789.75.

item.title: Gold, silver prices fall on MCX ahead of US inflation data
item.description: During early trade, MCX gold February contracts were trading 0.20 per cent lower at Rs 1,34,619 per 10 grams. "In INR gold has support at Rs 1,33,850-1,33,110 while resistance at Rs 1,35,350-1,35,970. Silver has support at Rs 2,05,650-2,03,280 while resistance at Rs 2,08,810, 2,10,270," experts stated.

item.title: Delhi enforces 'No PUC, No Fuel' rule from today; bars BS-VI vehicles from outside
item.description: Additionally, only BS-VI compliant vehicles registered outside Delhi will be allowed to enter the city from Thursday, while trucks carrying construction material will remain banned. Construction activity continues to be prohibited under GRAP norms, with strict action promised against violators.
